stem: On 1 October 2025, 300 businesses subscribed to Voltmarkt's Business Care (a monthly device-support plan for small offices) paid a total MRR of €15,000. On 1 October 2026 those same businesses pay €16,950 in total, with the ones that cancelled counted at €0. Businesses that subscribed during the year add another €4,000 of MRR. What is the 12-month net revenue retention? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
